{{Quote|I'm Eton Vok. I research the rakghouls' hunting patterns and social behaviors.|Eton Vok|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Eton Vok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] scientist of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] in [[3642 BBY]] he was on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] in the [[border assault post]] studying [[rakghoul]]s, in particular of [[Berserker rakghoul|Berserker]] variety.
